verdict.rationale: Recurly is an API-driven billing SaaS, so issuing scoped API credentials for an agent is a fair question for this kind of product. However, nothing in the evidence pack documents API key scopes, permission levels, or least-privilege credentials. The Compass MCP server and client libraries cover different stories and do not show credential scoping.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can issue scoped/least-privilege API credentials for an agent
